subject: general
question: Which Act of the British Parliament provided for responsible government in the provinces?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Act of 1935.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** 1935 Government of India Act** was a piece of legislation modified by the** British Parliament.**
 
• It called for the creation of all-Indian federations with units made up of** provinces and princely states.**
 
• The** Reserve Bank of India **was to be established under the act. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **1919 Government of India Act** includes a provision for the handover of power to the Indians.
 
• The Morley-Minto Reform is also known as the **Indian Council Act of 1909.**
 
• The** British Parliament passed the Indian Councils Act 1892**, which expanded the size of India's legislative councils.
